scope: Original scan 25 percent reduction: native preview count and GUI/public MCP lifecycle

explicitDeviationComparison.method: Enabled deviation, explicitly entered each tolerance and applied it to the native preview.

limitations: The QuickSurface 25 percent preview was not exported; matching triangle counts does not prove matching native geometry, normals, deviation values, or publication behavior.
Native source equivalence to the original scan relies on the earlier source control for scan-1(1).
This is one input and setting and is not general native or resource acceptance.
The two tolerance comparisons match displayed percentages rounded to two decimals; individual deviations, native preview coordinates and native object publication were not compared.

nativeReadOnlyCoordinateProbe.method: A real browser run captured the first vertex from the GUI 25 percent STL output. REA/Frida searched writable QuickSurface memory ranges no larger than 128 MiB while the native 25 percent preview was visible, then read those matching addresses after Cancel.
limitations: This is one coordinate, not a face or whole-mesh comparison; matching byte sequences cannot establish ownership by the active native preview.
All ten prior addresses had changed or were unreadable after Cancel, consistent with preview-related storage, but memory reuse and unrelated copies remain possible.
The scan excluded ranges larger than 128 MiB and capped reported matches at 50.
A second broader scan timed out and produced no usable evidence.
Native source triangle count returned to 273139 after Cancel; its complete post-cancel geometry was not re-exported.

nativeReadOnlyPrefixProbe.method: During the native 25 percent preview, REA scanned writable memory for the first GUI output vertex, searched nearby for the other two first-face vertices, and sampled coordinate fields at a 24-byte stride. An isolated GUI/MCP browser replay captured its ordered STL coordinates independently.
nativeReadOnlyPrefixProbe.sourceMemoryAfterCancel: The previously sampled address no longer contained the matched first vertex.
limitations: The sampled buffer is not independently bound to the active scene object or native exporter; the address changed after Cancel, consistent with preview-related storage but not proof of ownership.

The first 3740 faces match bit-for-bit; the sampled area is zero-filled at the next face. Remaining memory is not established as the continuation, so its divergent full digest is not evidence of a native geometry mismatch.
No native output file was exported; this does not prove all 68283 native faces, normals, publication, or general equivalence.
